title: Best flamenco show I've attended (and I've done four)
text: I have attended four different flamenco shows over the last 15 years, one in Barcelona and three in Sevilla. After my third experience in 2022 I said "enough, no more flamenco"- feeling underwhelmed by the whole experience. The only reason I went a fourth time was I was taking my adult daughter to Spain for her 50th birthday and asked her if this was something she wanted to do. She did so I uncovered this particular venue. We paid to include dinner, which was excellent from beginning to end, and the show was colorful and fresh and moved right along. Highly recommend!
author: Jan_M

title: A Truly Unforgettable Flamenco Experience in Seville!
text:
My husband and I had the most wonderful experience at the Seville Flamenco Show with Dinner and Flamenco Costume Museum. It was our first time experiencing a live Flamenco performance, and it completely exceeded our expectations!

The passion, energy, music, and incredible footwork of the dancers were absolutely mesmerising. Every movement was filled with emotion and artistry, and we could truly feel the soul and tradition of Andalusian Flamenco.

The experience was made even more special by the delicious full-course Andalusian dinner, accompanied by a full jar of Sangria.

title: A lovely evening.
text:
We had a lovely time. The meal was very tasty and provided ample food. There was also a very generous supply of beaverages. 
The show itself was a wonderful culture experience. The flamenco dancers were fabulous and we enjoyed the extra chance of a visit to the venues flamenco museum. Highly recommend.

title: Exceptional flamenco dance
text:
Attending a flamenco show in Seville was an unforgettable experience. The atmosphere was full of passion and intensity: every guitar note, every hand clapping and every dance step conveyed the most authentic soul of Andalusia.
The dancers were extraordinary, able to combine perfect technique and pure emotion; the singers, with their deep and powerful voices, made it all the more suggestive. The proximity to the stage allowed us to perceive every detail, as if we were part of the show itself.
